claims.statement: The supplied graph records a missing Core frontend-body boundary and a separate layout/adapter/compiler/staged-lowering boundary.
Core1 constants are moriarty/1 and moriarty-core/1; IR declarations set 8192 expressions,1024 statements,256 declarations and65536 trace cells.

Stage constants name moriarty/2, moriarty-core/2, moriarty-stage-plan/1, moriarty-continuation/1 and moriarty-stage-event/1; bounds are 16 awaits/action, 16 event binders, 256 captures, 4 MiB continuation and 65,536-byte event.

language(source) lexes source and checks its initial language string against only the two constants in this function. It is a routing function; this body does not parse/validate the rest as a Program.
admit_source calls language then routes Core1 to parse/admit_checked and Stage2 to stage::load/StagedAdmission::new.
admit_program delegates to admit_checked with no source hash; admit_checked calls require_core1,validate,then identity::program_hash before constructing AdmittedCore1.
require_core1 requires the Core1 language/semantics pair and refuses any Await statement in its supplied Program.
parse calls parse_profile(false); parse_profile checks EOF and invokes crate::validate only when staged is false.
load source order is parse_v2→require_core2→validate_v2→plan::build→plan_invariants→cost::fill→cost_invariants→program_hash→fill plan program_hash→plan_hash→StagedProgram.

lib.rs declares public Sherlock/source/bounded-source modules separately. Its draft source/typechecker/tests/image bridge modules are private and cfg(test). Their implementation bodies are absent from the 33-file parent source packet inventoried by core-frontend-source-input/MANIFEST.json; this parent count does not describe the bounded Part 1 reviewer workspace.

claims.statement: The inspected language/frontend dispatch exposes Core1 and Staged2 branches; separate Sherlock declarations are not an observed call edge into those branches. This is scoped to these bodies.
Type is UInt or Bool. Value uses serde type/value tagging with deny_unknown_fields. UInt wraps u128 and deserializes a decimal STRING with ASCII digits, no empty value and no leading zero except0.
Expression variants are LiabilityPresent,LiabilityAmount,Literal,Name,Binary,Not; BinaryOp enumerates Add/Sub/Mul/Eq/Ne/Lt/Le/Gt/Ge/And/Or. ExprId is u16.
StateDecl fields are name/ty/initial; InputDecl name/ty; AssetId network/issuer/reference/scale:u8; AssetDecl name/identity. These declarations deny unknown fields.

claims.statement: Statement variants and their literal fields include Await,Let,Requires,Ensures,Next,Emit,Transfer,Fee,Liability,Discharge. Program fields are language/semantics/name/states/assets/expressions/actions; Action fields name/inputs/statements.
Frozen v1 wire Statement excludes Await; shared Statement/Action/Program/Step/Execution Deserialize implementations route through v1 conversion. This is distinct from staged parsing of shared IR.

Balance fields account/asset/amount; Liability name/asset/debtor/creditor/amount; Scenario state/inputs/balances/liabilities derives Default but these Deserialize fields have no serde(default) annotation in this declaration.

claims.statement: Snapshot fields are state/balances/liabilities. Effect variants are declared as State/Transfer/Fee/Liability/Emit. Step.effects and Execution.effects are Vec<Effect> sequences; this wording does not imply PartialOrd or Ord for Effect. Execution fields are semantics/action/pre/post/steps/effects; Step fields are index:u16/statement/value:Option<Value>/snapshot/effects.

Parser expects language quoted-profile semicolon, agreement name braces, state name:type=literal semicolon; asset identity fields occur in fixed network,issuer,reference,scale order with optional trailing comma.

Actions use parenthesized typed inputs and a brace-delimited statement list. The alternative input name:type; syntax may appear before any statement. Parser checks statement and total declaration bounds.
ty() recognizes UInt/Bool. literal() handles true/false or Number tokens after removing underscores, parsing u128. push() refuses expression count at8192.
Expressions parse parentheses/not, literals, names and liability_present/amount with quoted names; source depth check is greater than64. Operator precedence branches are or1,and2,comparison3,+/-4,*5.
Statement parser names let,next,requires,ensures,emit,transfer,fee,liability,discharge and semicolon terminators. Await grammar is label(binders) when expression and is gated on LANGUAGE_2.

validate begins with exact language/semantics, agreement identifier, at least1 action and total declaration/expression bounds; state/asset declaration names and action names are checked in separate uniqueness passes.

identifier source predicate uses ASCII letter first, <=64 bytes and alphanumeric/underscore rest, excluding the literal reserved list. Assets require nonempty <=1024-byte network/issuer/reference, scale<=38, identity uniqueness and matching scales for equal triples.

citations.literal:
pub(crate) fn identifier(name: &str) -> bool {
    let mut bytes = name.bytes();
    matches!(bytes.next(), Some(b'A'..=b'Z' | b'a'..=b'z'))
        && name.len() <= 64
        && bytes.all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'_')
        && !matches!(
            name,
            "language"
                | "agreement"
                | "state"
                | "asset"
                | "action"
                | "input"
                | "let"
                | "next"
                | "requires"
                | "ensures"
                | "emit"
                | "transfer"
                | "fee"
                | "liability"
                | "discharge"
                | "true"
                | "false"
                | "and"
                | "or"
                | "not"
                | "UInt"
                | "Bool"
        )
}

claims.statement: Expression references must point to earlier nodes, derived depth<=64. Initial state values must match types. Action inputs<=256/statements<=1024; inputs cannot shadow declarations.

validate walks statements in order: Await profile error; Let adds a typed nonshadowing name; predicates require Bool; Next requires known state/matching type; effect names/account/duty strings and UInt amounts are checked in the displayed branches.

Core1 validate and staged validate_v2 both call validate_liability_reads. That function resolves read names against Liability declarations across all actions and checks matching source identities for read names.

claims.statement: validate_v2 additionally reserves await/when; validates16 awaits/action,16 binders/await,256 captures before a site, unique labels/nonshadowing binders, and Bool guard after adding its own binders.

Stage plan build records inputs first, then Lets and earlier event binders as captures; Await sites numbered1..N save the current capture vector. plan_invariants separately reconstructs expected sites and checks ordered sites/prefix captures before costing.
parse_json checks1MiB bytes and UTF8, calls Core parse_limited, then serde_json::from_value. No project code was invoked in this inspection.

parse_limited supplies a caller byte cap; parse_inner checks text length, deserializes with Seed, then calls deserializer.end(). Seed bounds source depth32/nodes65536, and object visitor rejects repeated decoded keys.

Selector uses camelCase/deny_unknown_fields: format/language/semantics/action/adapter/cap/accounting/frame are required fields; expectedSourceSha256 and expectedProgramHash explicitly default to None when absent.

TransitionInput has required kind tag: CoreReference{scenario} or Records{inputs,pre,post,effects}. ProveRequest has format/selector/transition/context; ContextInput lists typed networkId:u8,consumedIx:u16,seq:u64 plus strings and optional vkDigest(default None).
Source reader bound262144B, JSON bound1048576B; read_bounded requires a regular file and checks before/after read size. These are source branches, not reads performed by this task.

check_selector compares literal Core1 language/semantics, capNotBound, accountingGrossDebitAndFees, frameTouchedOnly and crate::ADAPTER; action length1..1024. The ADAPTER constant body is absent, while compile_selected explicitly passes SettlementHashV2.
compile_selected checks selector, builds explicit CompileOptions, invokes mori_r1cs::compile_source::<Fr>(...,SettlementHashV2), then constructs descriptor and checks optional pins.

compile_source calls frontend::admit_source: Core1 calls compile; Staged2 constructs Err(StagedNotLowered(Box::new(staged.lowering_plan()?))). This is a source branch, not an observed executed rejection.
compile calls compiler.checked,adapter.admits,optional abi2::options_ok,plan_action,StatementLayout::build,optional abi2::constants and probe in displayed source order.

CompileOptions action/cap/frame/accounting/compiler has no Default implementation in this declaration. Enum choices are NotBound/PublicCap,NotBound/GrossDebitAndFees,TouchedOnly/Include(Vec<CellRef>).

plan_action selects options.action; sorts states by name; gathers touched balance cells and source registry duties, reads reachable duty names; local source branch refuses external-duty identity absent source Liability introduction.
Effects and logical schedule are derived statement by statement; represented trace uses records*(statements+2), with <=65536 trace,4096 cells and1024 duties branches.
simulate_with_meter source calls validate→selected action→scenario_snapshot→state+input environment→ordered execute_statement→step snapshots→Execution. No simulation was run.
Binary expression body evaluates lhs then rhs and then dispatches operator; add/sub/mul use checked u128 operations. The fresh cache is allocated by evaluate for each root call.
Requires and Ensures share the immediate predicate branch at their statement position. Next updates current.state and env before pushing its State effect.

scenario_snapshot checks4096 balances/1024 liabilities/65536 trace product; empty supplied state chooses declaration initials, otherwise state is exact; input fields are exact selected action names/types. Balance and duty normalization/check branches are visible here.

lower_action iterates statements in order; lower_statement combines Requires/Ensures and replaces state/environment in Next. expr lowers lhs then rhs with fresh root memo. This records call order only and makes no correctness correspondence claim.

start calls scenario_snapshot→start_preflight→optional canonical_boundary→run_segment→finish. resume source order is selected action,format/profile,program/plan digest,action/site,captures,event,cost preflight,canonical_boundary,run_segment,finish.

run_segment Resume installs captures then event values and evaluates the pending guard; false returns NotAdvanced. On a next Await it captures named env slots and breaks, rather than evaluating that future guard in that segment.

statement_cost computes1+distinct reachable nodes; start preflight compares total to optional cap; resume checks planned committed work, checked needed cost and CLI/stored cap branches. These source formulas are not resource adequacy evidence.

NamedValue name/value; StageLogical profile/cap/committed with custom Option deserializer requiring cap key; Continuation format/program_hash/plan_hash/action/site/captures/logical/boundary; StageEvent format/action/label/values deny unknown fields.

fn binary(&self, cs: &mut Cs<F>, op: BinaryOp, a: CVal<F>, b: CVal<F>) -> Result<CVal<F>, GadgetError> {
        let shape = |m: &str| GadgetError::Static(format!("operand types differ from validated IR: {m}"));
        Ok(match (op, a, b) {
            (BinaryOp::Add, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::U(gadgets::add(cs, "add", &x, &y)?),
            (BinaryOp::Sub, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::U(gadgets::sub(cs, "sub", &x, &y)?),
            (BinaryOp::Mul, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::U(gadgets::mul(cs, "mul", &x, &y)?),
            (BinaryOp::Lt, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::lt(cs, "lt", &x, &y)?),
            (BinaryOp::Gt, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::lt(cs, "lt", &y, &x)?),
            (BinaryOp::Le, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::not(&gadgets::lt(cs, "lt", &y, &x)?)),
            (BinaryOp::Ge, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::not(&gadgets::lt(cs, "lt", &x, &y)?)),
            (BinaryOp::Eq, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::eq_uint(cs, "eq", &x, &y)?),
            (BinaryOp::Ne, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::not(&gadgets::eq_uint(cs, "eq", &x, &y)?)),
            (BinaryOp::Eq, CVal::B(x), CVal::B(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::eq_bool(cs, "beq", &x, &y)?),
            (BinaryOp::Ne, CVal::B(x), CVal::B(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::not(&gadgets::eq_bool(cs, "beq", &x, &y)?)),
            (BinaryOp::And, CVal::B(x), CVal::B(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::and(cs, "and", &x, &y)?),
            (BinaryOp::Or, CVal::B(x), CVal::B(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::or(cs, "or", &x, &y)?),
            (op, _, _) => return Err(shape(&format!("{op:?}"))),
